<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include">
    <sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <access>public</access>
        <active>true</active>
        <api_name>x_938076_now_utils.MarketBatchProcessUtils</api_name>
        <caller_access/>
        <client_callable>true</client_callable>
        <description>The MarketBatchProcessUtils script is a utility class designed to handle batch processing related to market schedules and time zone conversions.</description>
        <mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable>
        <name>MarketBatchProcessUtils</name>
        <sandbox_callable>true</sandbox_callable>
        <script><![CDATA[var MarketBatchProcessUtils = Class.create();
/**
 * MSSOTIQUBE-924
 * MarketBatchProcesUtils Prototype
 * This class provides utility functions to handle batch process scheduling
 * Time zone conversions,and settlement batch time adjustments.
 */
MarketBatchProcessUtils.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},

    /**
     * MSSOTIQUBE-924
     * Checks if logging is enabled via system property
     * @returns {Boolean}-True if logging is enabled,else false.
     */
    isLoggingEnabled: function() {
        enableLogging = gs.getProperty("x_hsb11_mss_custod.MarketBatchProcessUtils.enableLogging", 'false') === 'true'; //System property which can be enabled/disabled to control logging
        return enableLogging;
    },

    /**
     * MSSOTIQUBE-924
     * Logs a message if logging is enabled
     * @param{String} message-The message to log
     */
    log: function(message) {
        if (this.isLoggingEnabled()) {
            gs.info("[MarketBatchProcessUtils]: " + message);
        }
    },
    /**
     * MSSOTIQUBE-924
     * Retrieves the timezone associated with a give schedule name
     * @param {String} scheduleName-The name of the schedule
     * @returns {String} - The timezone as a string
     */
    getScheduledTimezone: function(scheduleName) {
        try {
            var schedule = new GlideSchedule(scheduleName);
            var timezone = schedule.getTimeZone();
            this.log("Retrieved timezone for schedule " + scheduleName + ":" + timezone); //MSSOTIQUBE-924
            return timezone.toString();
        } catch (e) {
            gs.error("[MarketBatchProcessUtils]-Error in retrieving time zone " + e.message); //MSSOTIQUBE-924
        }
    },

    /**
     * MSSOTIQUBE-924
     * Converts a given time(hour,minute) to the target timezone.
     * @param {Number} hour- The hour of the time to be converted
     * @param {Number} minute- The minute of the time to be converted
     * @param {String} targetTimezone-The target timezone
     * @returns {String}-The converted time in HH:mm format.
     */
    convertToTimezone: function(hour, minute, targetTimezone) {
        //var targetTZ = GlideTimeZone.getTimeZone(targetTimezone);
        try {
            var sourceDate = new GlideDateTime();
            sourceDate.setHourOfDay(hour);
            sourceDate.setMinute(minute);

            var targetDate = new GlideDateTime(targetTimezone);
            targetDate.setMillis(sourceDate.getMillis());
			var convertedTime=targetDate.getLocalTime().getFormattedTime('HH:mm');
            this.log("Converted time: "+ hour + ":" + minute + " to" + convertedTime +" in timezone" + targetTimezone);//MSSOTIQUBE-924
            return convertedTime;
        } catch (e) {
            gs.error("[MarketBatchProcessUtils]-Error converting time " + e.message); //MSSOTIQUBE-924
        }
    },

    /**
     * MSSOTIQUBE-924
     * Adjust the settlement batch value based on schedule and time zone differences
     * @param{String} schedule-The schedule name
     * @param{String} settlementDateBatch-The original settlement batch time
     * @return{String}-The transformed batch time based on timezone adjustments
     */
    getSettlementDateBatchValue: function(Schedule, settlementDateBatch) {
        try {
            var getTargetTimeZone, getTargetTZ, currentdateTime, currentdateTimeNumeric, tzConvert, TargetTime, targetTimeG, numericdiff, differenece, actualdifferenceinMins, transformedValueSingle, settlementDate, hhmm, hh, mm, newHH, newMM, newValuehours, newValueMins;
            var transformedValue = [];

            getTargetTZ = new MarketBatchProcessUtils();
            getTargetTimeZone = getTargetTZ.getScheduledTimezone(Schedule);

            currentdateTime = new GlideDateTime();
            currentdateTimeNumeric = new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue();

            tzConvert = new GlideScheduleDateTime(currentdateTime);
            tzConvert.setTimeZone(getTargetTimeZone);

            TargetTime = tzConvert.getGlideDateTime().getDisplayValue();
            targetTimeG = GlideDateTime(TargetTime).getNumericValue();

            numericdiff = targetTimeG - currentdateTimeNumeric;
            differenece = ((numericdiff) / (1000 * 60));


            if (differenece < 0) {
                numericdiff = currentdateTimeNumeric - targetTimeG;
                differenece = ((numericdiff) / (1000 * 60));
                actualdifferenceinMins = Math.floor(differenece);
				this.log("Time difference calculated: "+actualdifferenceinMins+" minutes.");//MSSOTIQUBE-924
                // gs.info('MarketBatchProcessUtils getSettlementDateBatchValue differenece : ' + differenece + '\n actualdifferenceinMins : '+actualdifferenceinMins);

                if (settlementDateBatch && settlementDateBatch.length < 5) {
                    hh = settlementDateBatch.substr(0, 2);
                    mm = settlementDateBatch.substr(2, 4);

                    newHH = (hh * 60 - actualdifferenceinMins) / 60;
                    newMM = (hh * 60 + mm - actualdifferenceinMins) % 60;

                    //To cover the screnario that batch time is in UK evening
                    if (newHH < 0)
                        newHH = newHH + 24;

                    newValuehours = (('00' + newHH).slice(-2));
                    newValueMins = (('00' + newMM).slice(-2));
                    transformedValueSingle = newValuehours + newValueMins;
                    return transformedValueSingle;

                } else {


                    var values = settlementDateBatch.split(',');
                    for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
                        hhmm = values[i];
                        hh = hhmm.slice(0, -2).padStart(2, '0');
                        mm = hhmm.slice(-2).padStart(2, '0');

                        newHH = (hh * 60 - actualdifferenceinMins) / 60;
                        newMM = (hh * 60 + mm - actualdifferenceinMins) % 60;

                        //To cover the screnario that batch time is in UK evening
                        if (newHH < 0)
                            newHH = newHH + 24;

                        newValuehours = (('00' + newHH).slice(-2));
                        newValueMins = (('00' + newMM).slice(-2));
                        transformedValueSingle = newValuehours + newValueMins;
                        transformedValue.push(transformedValueSingle);
                        //gs.info('MarketBatchProcessUtils Change Timezone : hhmm : ' + hhmm + '\n hh : ' + hh + '\n mm : ' + mm + '\n newValuehours : ' + newValuehours + '\n newValueMins : ' + newValueMins + '\n transformedValueSingle : '+transformedValueSingle);
                    }

                    var tValueMultiple = transformedValue.toString();

                    this.log('Change Timezone : tValueMultiple : ' + tValueMultiple);//MSSOTIQUBE-924
                    return tValueMultiple;



                }
            }
        } catch (e) {
            gs.error("[MarketBatchProcessUtils]-Error processing settlement batch " + e.message); //MSSOTIQUBE-924	
        }
    },

    type: 'MarketBatchProcessUtils'
};]]></script>
